title: THE SCORE CAPTION CLEARS THE TOP EDGE
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 (bug B4) and his note that the text at the top middle is colliding: the SCORE caption over the score figure was cut by the top edge of the screen in a CAREER or DEMO raid, its capitals losing their tops. The whole top stack (the score block, the compass line and the extraction marks under it) now starts a little lower in those raids, so the caption has a margin under the edge.
now: The SCORE caption at the top centre now has a margin under the top edge.
